scene.heading: EXT. LOADING DOCK - NIGHT
scene.original_script:
[Scene 1] EXT. LOADING DOCK - NIGHT
The loading dock is quiet. A security guard walks past holding a flashlight.
scene.revised_script:
[Scene 1] EXT. LOADING DOCK - NIGHT
The loading dock is quiet. A security guard walks past holding a flashlight.
Suddenly, a pyrotechnic flash pot explodes near the dumpster.
A masked performer jumps from a 20-foot elevated platform down to the concrete, rolling to safety.
The crew resets the powered hydraulic lift between takes.

department_deltas.impact: Requires setup, perimeter clearance, and execution of practical pyrotechnics.
Stunt performer required for physical fall/jump action and deceleration mats.
Fall protection and elevated platform rigging required.
Powered mobile equipment / hydraulic lift operation.

Mandatory pre-take clearances required per Alberta OHS Code.

statutory_citations.title: Mandatory Hazard Assessment Revision
statutory_citations.statute_text: An employer must ensure that the hazard assessment is repeated before work begins on a new work site or when a work process or operation changes.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 28, s.498 (Pyrotechnics & Special Effects)
statutory_citations.title: Pyrotechnic Devices & Flash Pots
statutory_citations.statute_text: Pyrotechnic special effects require an authorized special effects pyrotechnician, local fire jurisdiction permit, and an enforced 50-foot safety exclusion perimeter.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 2, s.9 (Hazard Assessment & Stunt Coordination)
statutory_citations.title: High-Risk Physical Stunts & Acrobatics
statutory_citations.statute_text: High-velocity falls, vehicle stunts, and performer combat require a stunt coordinator walk-through, rehearsal inspection, and crash deceleration zones.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 9, s.139 (Fall Protection Systems)
statutory_citations.title: Working at Heights (>= 3 Metres)
statutory_citations.statute_text: An employer must ensure that a fall protection system is used where a worker or performer may fall 3 metres (approx 10 feet) or more.
clears: Key Rigger / Fall Protection Clear (Dana Rigger)

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 19, s.256 (Powered Mobile Equipment)
statutory_citations.title: Powered Mobile Equipment & Lifts
statutory_citations.statute_text: Powered hydraulic lifts, telescopic handlers, and condor cranes require certified operators, visual spotters, and cleared travel lanes.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 13, s.212 (Hazardous Energy Control / LOTO)
statutory_citations.title: Lockout / Tagout & Hydraulic Energy Isolation
statutory_citations.statute_text: Before servicing, resetting, or reloading powered mechanical lifts or hydraulic rigs between takes, all energy sources must be isolated and verified zero-state.
